variants.name: 5.45x39mm
variants.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.45x39mm. It was never adopted simply because it was redundant compared to 7.62x39mm performance out of a shorter barrel. Average range performance and comes with a 45rd magazine!

variants.name: 5.56x45mm
variants.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.56x45mm NATO. It never went into production due to project funding issues. Improves weapon accuracy drastically but reduces overall damage and range.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
